# 2 Baruch Chapter 28 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**28:1** And he answered and said to me: Whatever will be at that time will bear the seal of that period; it will last twelve years.

**28:2** And I said to him: But is it good for a man to live at that time?

**28:3** And he answered and said to me: Do not ask me about that.

**28:4** For those who will be living then will not perceive any distress, because they will not know that it is the end of the times.

**28:5** And those who are righteous and wise at that time will not perceive the tribulations, for they will have gone forth from this world.

**28:6** But the many who are not wise — those will be in great distress.

**28:7** And it will come to pass that after all these things, when the time of the appointed end has been fulfilled, the Anointed One will begin to be revealed.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering. Key decisions: "Anointed One" (v.7) over "Messiah" — LOGOS and EMET use "Anointed One" to translate the Syriac meshicha; "will begin to be revealed" (v.7) preserves the inceptive aspect of the Syriac verb, which PNEUMA's "will be revealed" loses; the ironic preservation of the righteous through death (v.5) is appropriately understated.*
